credential_unreadable: The stored credential cannot be read. Edit it and enter it again.
pagination_invalid_response: The backend returned a result page with an invalid format.
pagination_missing_next_cursor: The backend reported more results but did not provide the next cursor.
pagination_repeated_cursor: The backend repeated the pagination cursor.
resource_execution_in_progress: This resource is already in progress for your user. Wait for it to finish or stop the current execution.
session_cookie_discarded: The browser discarded the session: the app is served from {app} and the selected backend is {backend}. Session cookies are SameSite=Lax and do not travel across sites — and "127.0.0.1" is a different site from "localhost" even on the same machine. Pick a backend with the same host as the app.
